notes: Endless runs now save after every wave. Continue them any time from the Play page.
In Endless, the trail now stays the same all run. Only the world and its conditions change every 5 waves.

Mobile polish: no more accidental zooming (pinch, double-tap or tapping a text box), no stuck highlights after tapping, no pull-to-refresh or long-press menus, and the game pauses itself if you leave mid-wave.
PC controls: Space, 1–9 to pick lanterns, U to upgrade, M to merge, F for speed, P to pause, Esc or right-click to cancel.
